info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Loan By Loan Id-spec
info.description: The Loan Details Retrieval API provides businesses with the ability to access specific loan information using a unique loan identifier. This endpoint allows consumers, such as loan officers or financial analysts, to retrieve detailed records for loans, aiding in decision-making and customer service. Operations performed through this API include fetching pertinent data about loans like outstanding balances, repayment status, and borrower information. The API is designed for use in financial applications and systems requiring detailed loan visibility.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details for a specific loan using its unique identifier. It returns comprehensive information about the loan, including terms, amounts, and related data.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve details for the loan identified by LOAN-500045. The request body should conform to the specified JSON schema.
